bullets.text: Built a privacy-first Machine Learning RAG pipeline documenting legacy PHP/JS codebases with no code leaving company infrastructure: LangChain ingestion, 2,000-character chunking, Linq-Embed-Mistral embeddings in a local Chroma store, and Llama 3 via Ollama; retrieval surrounds each chunk with related cross-file context, achieving a 90% reduction in manual documentation work.
Developed an automated call-quality assessment pipeline using Machine Learning, WhisperX transcription, and LLM analysis, replacing manual QA audits.
Ran internal workshops on LLM capabilities and prompt engineering, accelerating Machine Learning tooling adoption across the development team.
